mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_detail ( group_code, code, code_name, reference_value_1, reference_value_2, display_sequence, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time ) VALUES ( #{groupCode}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{referenceValue1}, #{referenceValue2}, #{displaySequence}, #{registId}, #{registDateTime}, #{modifyId}, #{modifyDateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT group_code, code, code_name, reference_value_1, reference_value_2, display_sequence, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM code_detail

SELECT group_code, code, code_name, reference_value_1, reference_value_2, display_sequence, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM code_detail WHERE group_code = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}
mapper.update: UPDATE code_detail SET code_name = #{codeName}, reference_value_1 = #{referenceValue1}, reference_value_2 = #{referenceValue2}, display_sequence = #{displaySequence}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, modify_date_time = #{modifyDateTime} WHERE group_code = #{groupCode} AND code = #{code}
